g.text: Critical flow — one /analyze request, failover and terminal status
PRODUCTION SCALE TIER · interview design, not built · ADR-0009, 0011, 0013, 0014 · SSE carries progress only: no draft text reaches the browser before verification and output policy
LLM FAILOVER LADDER (draft and verifier alike)
QUERY EMBEDDING LADDER (index belongs to one model)
GET /jobs/{id}/events (BFF session; browser holds no token)
: heartbeat every 15 s · Valkey pub/sub · reconnect replays from Postgres
-- worker A (attempt 3) dies; lease expires; worker B claims attempt 4
WHERE id = $id AND attempt = $fence; -- 0 rows ⇒ stale worker, result discarded
